findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#s1-docs-orbit" for scale between 5.40s and 5.50s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 862 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: Two text blocks overlap and may render unreadable.
findings.fixHint: Give each block its own zone, or put data-layout-allow-overlap on the text or on a container inside the scene. A marker on the scene root does not apply. Decoration nobody needs to read can take data-layout-ignore.
